mapper.insert: INSERT INTO plan_route_map_jobs ( route_map_id, plan_id, user_id, day_number, style, status, trigger_type, locked_by, locked_until, attempts, max_attempts, error_code, error_message, available_at, started_at, completed_at, created_at, updated_at ) VALUES ( #{routeMapId}, #{planId}, #{userId}, #{dayNumber}, #{style}, COALESCE(#{status}, 'queued'), #{triggerType}, #{lockedBy}, #{lockedUntil}, COALESCE(#{attempts}, 0), COALESCE(#{maxAttempts}, 3), #{errorCode}, #{errorMessage}, COALESCE(#{availableAt}, NOW()), #{startedAt}, #{completedAt}, NOW(), NOW() )
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM plan_route_map_jobs WHERE id = #{id} LIMIT 1
SELECT * FROM plan_route_map_jobs WHERE route_map_id = #{routeMapId} ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT 1
mapper.update: UPDATE plan_route_map_jobs SET status = 'running', locked_by = #{lockedBy}, locked_until = #{lockedUntil}, attempts = attempts + 1, started_at = NOW(), updated_at = NOW() WHERE id = #{id} AND status IN ('queued', 'retrying')
UPDATE plan_route_map_jobs SET status = 'succeeded', completed_at = NOW(), locked_until = NULL, updated_at = NOW() WHERE id = #{id}

UPDATE plan_route_map_jobs SET status = #{status}, error_code = #{errorCode}, error_message = #{errorMessage}, available_at = #{availableAt}, completed_at = CASE WHEN #{status} = 'dead_letter' THEN NOW() ELSE completed_at END, locked_until = NULL, updated_at = NOW() WHERE id = #{id}
UPDATE plan_route_map_jobs SET status = 'dead_letter', error_code = #{errorCode}, error_message = #{errorMessage}, completed_at = NOW(), locked_until = NULL, updated_at = NOW() WHERE id = #{id}
